mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_book (title, author, price, stock) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{price}, #{stock})
mapper.sql: b.*,bc.category_id,COALESCE(ri.resource_type,'图书') AS resource_type, COALESCE(ri.language,'') AS language,ri.author_unit,ri.publisher,ri.publish_date,ri.identifier,ri.description, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.name ORDER BY c.id SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_category c WHERE c.id=bc.category_id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_resource_category rc WHERE rc.book_id=b.id AND rc.category_id=c.id)) AS category_name
LEFT JOIN t_book_category bc ON bc.book_id=b.id LEFT JOIN t_resource_info ri ON ri.book_id=b.id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_book b WHERE b.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM t_book b WHERE b.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE t_book SET stock = stock - #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity}
